yard.description: Everyone measured at a yard counts as one group. Shows which yard has the highest exposure overall, and whether one stands out from the others.

aboutFigures.title: Limits and calculation
aboutFigures.description: The action and limit values the figures are compared with, how the figures are calculated, and where they come from.

source.groups: Each group is everyone measured in one yard or building. With “{{perOccupation}}”, each occupation group there is its own group.
source.hourly: The data only has figures for the whole group: one value per hour and shares per day. Each person's measurements aren't stored.

calculation.periodAverage: The figure shown is the average of the days in the period. Days without measurements aren't counted.
calculation.timeOver: Time above: Ola has measurements in 8 hours, and 2 of them were at the action value or more: 2 / 8 = 25 %. Kari: 0 / 8 = 0 %. The group: (25 % + 0 %) / 2 = 12.5 %. Each worker counts the same. Time above the limit value is calculated the same way.
calculation.timeOverVibration: Vibration: Ola reaches the action value at 09:00 and has 8 hours of measurements from 07:00. The hours from 09:00 count: 6 / 8 = 75 %. Hours after Ola has stopped don't count.

exposure.dust: {{dustField}} TWA in {{unit}}. At 08:00: Ola 4 and Kari 6 give 5 for the group. The day's figure is the average of the hours.
exposure.noise: LAeq in {{unit}}. At 08:00: Ola 80 and Kari 84 give 82 for the group. The day's figure is the average of the hours. Note: 80 and 90 give 85 here, even though the sound energy equals about 87. Peak values (LCpk) aren't included in “time above”.
exposure.vibration: Vibration points. Ola: 40 + 30 + 50 = 120 points that day. The day's figure is the average of the daily totals of everyone with measurements. The total starts at 0 each day.

missing.noData: “No data” = no measurements. 0 % = there are measurements, but none were above.
missing.suppressed: Groups have at least {{count}} registered people. A single day can still have measurements from fewer.
